verdict.rationale: Rendering strategy and devtools debuggability are fair questions for any UI framework, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never says Angular renders real DOM nodes or that its UI can be debugged in browser devtools. The nearest items, third-party libraries like D3 working without 'angularizing' and a complaint that framework source is hard to debug, are about other subjects and give no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug my UI directly in browser devtools because the framework renders real DOM nodes
